title: Shift Crew Bonus Points
brief: A warehouse assigns pickers to stations in a single row and scores each one's shift. Payroll hands out bonus points so every picker gets something, and anyone who outscored the picker at an adjacent station gets strictly more points than that neighbor.
Implement minimumBonusPoints(scores), where scores[i] is the shift score of the picker at station i, and return the smallest total number of points that satisfies those rules.
